name: Gut Feelings
source:
Whoever said married life was boring clearly never had anything bad happen in their life. Good for them, but after experiencing the worlds most explosive backstab by a lifelong friend, Tadhg is ready to settle into domestic bliss.

Of course, marrying a stress prone musician with a love for exceptionally rotund men has left him settling into quite a bit of weight as well... Not that you'll be hearing Tadhg complain. If his spouse loves him more with every ounce, so be it. And with Asancur returning from a months long tour, Tadhg is more than ready to put on a show of his own for his lovie.

He's practically an expert at this 'gaining' thing now. What could possibly go wrong?

[From [url=https://foxglove-vn-productions.itch.io/gut-feelings?]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
那些说婚姻生活很无聊的人显然在他们的生活中从未发生过任何不好的事情。这对他们来说是件好事，但在经历了一生朋友的世界上最具爆炸性的背刺之后，塔格准备好享受家庭幸福了。

当然，嫁给一个容易承受压力、又喜欢特别圆润的男人的音乐家，也让他体重增加了很多……并不是说你会听到塔格抱怨。如果他的配偶更加爱他，那就这样吧。随着阿桑库尔 (Asancur) 从长达一个月的巡演归来，塔赫 (Tadhg) 已经准备好为他的爱人上演一场属于自己的表演。

他现在几乎是这方面的专家了。可能会出现什么问题？
